verdict: 28-day ROAS holds at 4.44x, but the last 7 days are softening fast.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered $6,574.82 in revenue on $1,479.64 in spend — a 4.44x return — with 41 purchases and 902 clicks. The concern is what's happened in the most recent 7 days: purchases are down 30% and return on ad spend is down 27% versus the prior 7 days, on almost identical daily spend, pointing to audience fatigue on the top-running campaign. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to break the pattern before the efficiency floor erodes further. Expect the next 7 days to be the reset window — if creative lands, purchase rate should stabilize heading into October.
